cards.name: collatz
cards.summary: 65.1 kB, halts at step 111, verified against Wasm under 4 browser arithmetic models

warnings.message: the card updates 20 times per second (stepMs 50); every update restyles and repaints the display, so viewers' CPU use grows with the rate

loops is "infinite": the card keeps updating for as long as the page is open and the card is on screen (WebKit also while it is scrolled out of view); "auto" plays for about a minute and then rests on the last step, which costs nothing
300 steps: the first render computes every step and the file grows with each one (8.2 kB gzip); a shorter run or a halt condition keeps both small
